## Lesson and version

Notebook name, release or commit, and whether its inputs were changed.

## Environment

Operating system or Colab runtime, Python, PyTorch, CPU/GPU and precision.
Do not include tokens, account details or private paths.

## Steps and result

Provide a minimal reproduction, the first complete error if any, and expected
versus observed output. Record setup time separately from whole-notebook time.

## Checks and figures

Which assertions passed or failed? Include relevant field/error plots, not just
the elapsed time. Do not remove failed checks to obtain a completed notebook.
